notes: Coordinate system: browser Three.js, +Y up, world XZ plane.
UE mapping: X_ue = X_web, Y_ue = Y_web(up), Z_ue = -Z_web (left-handed swap).
All rows land verbatim in this dump; the UE side re-reads them at build time.
Primary source is the feat/world-visuals worktree (newest rulings C1..C16); the dev checkout config is a subset.

rotmother.name: Rot Mother
rotmother.poisonText: Rot poison - your limbs go heavy

rot-silk.name: Rot-Silk
rot-silk.flavor: Damp grey thread, spun to swaddle young that never woke
rot-silk.dropLog: Rot-Silk: she wove it soft, and wrapped each one as if it might still breathe.

rot-gland.name: Rot-Gland
rot-gland.flavor: A swollen sac, still warm, still trying to make milk
rot-gland.dropLog: Rot-Gland: it kept working after everything else in her had given up.
